author: claude-code
head: a235637bd28cb2a15c12a4bb9401f23ed51f5b68
body: Orchestrator review of PR #355 (dotfiles-T128-gate-wrapper-path-a01: scripts/orchestrator/orch-gate.sh runs the gate and every process it starts with a private PATH, one directory of symlinks gh and git resolved in the trusted root (mise which, else command -v) before the review worktree is entered, a result under a shims directory refused with exit 2 before the head checkout, the EXIT trap set before mktemp -d so the directory is removed on every exit; tests/unit/test_orch_gate_path.py with its three tests on stubs whose shebangs and recorders are absolute; three named edits to tests/unit/test_orchestrator_tools.py and nothing else there) at its final head: every item of the task's Files section is implemented and nothing else; the Bot's single review (on PR open) found one P1 (a caller's MISE_CONFIG_FILE or MISE_TRUSTED_CONFIG_PATHS could steer mise which), fixed in the one round by running mise which under env -i with PATH and HOME only, with its test; the local review and the audit of the final head are each fixed in the head or advisory, owned by dotfiles-T128-orchestrator-tools-followup-a01 on main; the caps (200 changed lines outside tests/, 1000 under tests/) hold; the task copy on the branch is the masker's output of the dispatched file (the premise's home path masked), byte-equal to it after the same mask. Approved for the gate at the audited head.
